star_growth.baseline_note: Measured from the stargazer timeline: 281 stars carry a starred_at strictly before 2026-07-20T00:00:00Z, 282 including the star of 2026-07-20, and the 284th star arrived on 2026-07-31. star_curve_monthly.note: New stars per calendar month, measured from the stargazer timestamps. The series is cumulative and has never fallen: no star has ever been unstarred in a way the timeline shows.

traffic.referrers_note: The window advanced this time: the endpoint served 2026-11-09 → 2026-11-22, the fourteen days ending the day before this collection, where 2026-W49 read the same window twice (2026-11-06 → 2026-11-19). The views therefore fell (733 → 655) as the oldest days left the window, while the unique visitors rose (185 → 202). The release-wave collector read the same endpoint at 2026-11-23T02:16Z and got 689 views / 199 uniques - a third reading of the same rolling window, taken three hours earlier. GitHub's traffic data cannot attribute a star to a referrer, so the split is reported as visits, never as caused stars.
